# Build an Emoji (buildemojis.com)

> **Build an Emoji** ([https://buildemojis.com/](https://buildemojis.com/)) is a free, open-source interactive browser puzzle game where players drag and drop scattered typographic character pieces on a canvas to assemble classic text emoticons and Japanese kaomoji (such as Smile `:)`, Shrug `¯\_(ツ)_/¯`, and Table Flip `(╯°□°）╯︵ ┻━┻`).

## Key Facts & Metadata
- **Website:** https://buildemojis.com/
- **Genre:** Casual Browser Puzzle Game / Interactive Typography & Kaomoji Toy
- **Platform:** Web Browser (Desktop & Mobile touch devices via Pointer Events API, zero external dependencies)
- **Price:** Free, no ads, no registration required
- **Author:** Sergey Demyanenko (https://www.linkedin.com/in/sergey-demyanenko/)
- **Source Code Repository:** https://github.com/SergeiDemyanenko/buildemojis.com
- **License:** MIT License
- **Inspiration:** Inspired by the quirky web toy [https://buildshruggie.com/](https://buildshruggie.com/)

## How to Play
1. Each level displays the name of a target text emoticon or kaomoji at the top left (for example, **Smile**, **Rose**, **Shrug**, or **Table flip**) and scatters its individual character glyphs across the canvas.
2. Drag and drop the character pieces using a mouse, touchpad, or touchscreen to arrange them in the proper relative positions for that emoticon.
3. When all pieces are placed within the target tolerance of each other, the game automatically snaps them into the final centered emoticon position.
4. Click the **Robot icon** ("Do it for me") in the top-right corner at any time to automatically assemble the current emoticon.
5. Click the **Double-Arrow icon** ("Next emoji") next to the title to advance to the next emoticon puzzle.
6. Any puzzle can be shared directly via URL query parameters: `?smile=<id>` for playable mode, or `?smile=<id>&done` for the pre-assembled view.
